problems.reason: Both sentences state that Panoplosaurus weighed 1600 kg.
Sentence 16 places Panoplosaurus in the family Nodosauridae, while sentence 17 states it was classified in the family Ankylosauridae.
Sentence 23 dates the species to the middle Campanian (≈76–75 Ma), whereas sentence 27 gives a broader range of 79–73 Ma for the late Cretaceous Campanian stage.
Both sentences state that Panoplosaurus lived in Alberta, Canada (North America) during the late Cretaceous, repeating the same location claim.
